title: Kindness and the Secret of Life
speaker: George Saunders

sentences.en: [Dean George Langford speaking] George is one of our most accomplished professors.
sentences.zh: 乔治是我们最杰出的教授之一

sentences.en: And it was really gracious of him to agree to be our speaker today.
sentences.zh: 他非常慷慨地同意今天发言。

sentences.en: Please join me now to welcome Professor George Saunders [clapping] Hi everybody, congratulations you did a great job.
sentences.zh: 请与我一起欢迎乔治·桑德斯教授 大家好 恭喜你们干得不错

sentences.en: Down through the ages, a traditional form has evolved for this type of speech, which is: Some old fart, his best years behind him, who, over the course of his life, has made a series of dreadful mistakes (that would be me),
sentences.zh: 古老的年代,一种传统的形式 演化了这种演讲,那就是: 一些老屁,他最好的年头, 在他的一生中, 他犯了一系列可怕的错误(那就是我),

sentences.en: gives heartfelt advice to a group of shining, energetic young people, with all of their best years ahead of them (that would be you).
sentences.zh: 向一群光辉、精力充沛的年轻人 提供忠告, 让他们拥有最美好的岁月(即你)。

sentences.en: And I intend to respect that tradition. Now, one useful thing you can do with an old person, in addition to borrowing money from them,
sentences.zh: 我打算尊重这个传统。现在,你可以用一个老人做一个有用的事, 除了从他们那里借钱之外,

sentences.en: or asking them to do one of their old-time "dances," so you can watch, while laughing, is ask: "Looking back, what do you regret?" And they'll tell you.
sentences.zh: 或者叫他们跳一段旧的舞, 这样你就可以在笑的时候看着, 问: “回头看,你会后悔什么?” 他们会告诉你的。

sentences.en: Sometimes, as you know, they'll tell you even if you haven't asked.
sentences.zh: 有时候,你知道, 他们会告诉你,即使你还没有问。

sentences.en: Sometimes, even when you've specifically requested they not tell you, they'll tell you.
sentences.zh: 有时 即使你特别要求他们不告诉你 他们会告诉你的

sentences.en: So, : What do I regret? Being poor from time to time? Not really. Working terrible jobs, like "knuckle-puller in a slaughterhouse?" (And don't even ASK what that entails.)
sentences.zh: 那么,我后悔什么?不时贫穷吗?不是真的。工作很糟糕,比如说“在屠宰场里打手枪?” (甚至不问这需要什么。 )

sentences.en: No. I don't regret that. Skinny-dipping in a river in Sumatra, a little buzzed, and looking up and seeing like 300 monkeys sitting on a pipeline, pooping down into the river, t
sentences.zh: 不,我不后悔,在苏门答腊的一条河里 裸泳了一下

sentences.en: the river in which I was swimming, with my mouth open, naked?
sentences.zh: 我在河里游泳, 嘴张开,裸体?

sentences.en: And getting deathly ill afterwards, and staying sick for the next seven months?
sentences.zh: 之后病得要死 以后七个月还要继续生病吗?

sentences.en: Not so much. Do I regret the occasional humiliation?
sentences.zh: 少来,我偶尔会后悔吗?

sentences.en: Like once, playing hockey in front of a big crowd, including this girl I really liked, I somehow managed, while falling and emitting this weird whooping noise, to score on my own goalie, while also sending my stick flying into the crowd, nearly hitting that girl? No. I don't even regret that.
sentences.zh: 就像一次,在人群面前玩曲棍球, 包括我真正喜欢的这个女孩, 我不知何故设法, 倒下和发出这种怪异的叫喊声, 在我的自己的守门员上得分, 同时把我的棍子飞到人群中, 差点撞到那个女孩?

sentences.en: But here's something I do regret: In seventh grade, this new kid joined our class. In the interest of confidentiality, her Convocation Speech name will be "ELLEN."
sentences.zh: 但有件事我很后悔:在七年级,这个新来的孩子加入了我们的班级。为了保密起见,她的演讲名将是“ELLEN”。

sentences.en: ELLEN was small, shy. She wore these blue cat's-eye glasses that, at the time, only old ladies wore.
sentences.zh: ELLEN很小 害羞 她戴着蓝猫眼眼镜

sentences.en: When nervous, which was pretty much always, she had a habit of taking a strand of hair into her mouth and chewing on it. Which did not help with popularity at all.
sentences.zh: 紧张的时候,她总是习惯把一股头发塞进嘴里,嚼它。这对受欢迎一点帮助都没有。

sentences.en: So she came to our school and our neighborhood, and was mostly ignored, occasionally teased ("Your hair taste good?"--that sort of thing). I could see this hurt her.
sentences.zh: 于是她来到了我们的学校 和我们的邻里, 大部分被忽略, 偶尔被嘲笑("你的头发味道不错?")。我可以看到这伤害了她。

sentences.en: I still remember the way she'd look after such an insult: eyes cast down, a little gut-kicked, as if, having just been reminded of her place in things, she was trying, as much as possible, to disappear. After awhile she'd drift away, hair-strand still in her mouth.
sentences.zh: 我还记得她会怎么照顾这种侮辱: 眼睛掉下来了, 有点胆小,好像刚被提醒到自己在事物中的位置, 她试图尽可能地消失。 过了一段时间后,她漂走了, 发丝还躺在她的嘴里。

sentences.en: At home, I imagined, after school, her mother would say, you know: "How was your day, sweetie?
sentences.zh: 在家里,我想象,放学后,她妈妈会说:"你今天过得怎么样,亲爱的?

sentences.en: and she'd say, "Oh, fine." And her mother would say, "Making any friends?" and she'd go, "Sure, lots."
sentences.zh: 她会说,"哦,很好。" 她妈妈会说,"交朋友?" 她会说,"当然,很多"

sentences.en: Sometimes I'd see her hanging around alone in her front yard, as if afraid to leave it.
sentences.zh: 有时我会看到她独自在院子里晃晃 好像害怕离开一样

sentences.en: And then--they moved. That was it. No tragedy, no big final hazing. One day she was there, next day she wasn't.
sentences.zh: 没有悲剧,没有大场面 有一天她在那里,第二天她不在

sentences.en: End of story.Now, why do I regret that? Why, forty-two years later, am I still thinking about her? Relative to most of the other kids, I was actually pretty nice to her.
sentences.zh: 说完了,为什么我后悔了?

sentences.en: I never said an unkind word to her. In fact, I sometimes even (mildly) defended her.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有对她说过一句不客气的话。事实上，有时我什至（温和地）为她辩护。

sentences.en: But still. It bothers me.So here's something I know to be true, although it's a little corny, and I don't quite know what to do with it: What I regret most in my life are failures of kindness.
sentences.zh: 但仍然。这让我很困扰。所以，我知道这是真的，尽管有点老套，而且我不太知道该怎么办：我一生中最遗憾的是没有表现出善意。

sentences.en: Those moments when another human being was there, in front of me, suffering, and I responded ... sensibly. Reservedly. Mildly.
sentences.zh: 当另一个人在我面前受苦时，我做出了明智的回应。有所保留。温和地。

sentences.en: Or, to look at it from the other end of the telescope: Who, in your life, do you remember most fondly, with the most undeniable feelings of warmth?Those who were kindest to you, I bet.
sentences.zh: 或者，从望远镜的另一端来看：在你的生命中，谁是你记忆最深刻、最有不可否认的温暖的人？我敢打赌，他们是对你最友善的人。

sentences.en: It's a little facile, maybe, and certainly hard to implement, but I'd say, as a goal in life, you could do worse than: Try to be kinder.
sentences.zh: 也许这有点容易，而且确实很难实施，但我想说，作为人生的目标，你可以做得比以下更糟糕：尝试变得更友善。

sentences.en: Now, the million-dollar question: Why aren't we kinder? What's our problem?
sentences.zh: 现在，一个价值百万美元的问题是：我们为什么不变得更友善一些？我们的问题是什么？

sentences.en: Here's what I think:Each of us is born with a series of built-in confusions that are probably somehow Darwinian. These are: (1) we're central to the universe (that is, our personal story is the main and most interesting story,
sentences.zh: 我的想法是这样的：我们每个人生来就有一系列内在的困惑，这些困惑可能在某种程度上是达尔文主义的。它们是：（1）我们是宇宙的中心（也就是说，我们的个人故事是主要且最有趣的故事，

sentences.en: the only story, really); (2) we're separate from the universe (there's US and then, out there, all that other junk--dogs and swing-sets, and the State of Nebraska
sentences.zh: 唯一的故事，真的）； （2）我们与宇宙是分开的（有美国，然后，那里有所有其他垃圾——狗和秋千，还有内布拉斯加州

sentences.en: and low-hanging clouds and, you know, other people), and (3) we're permanent (death is real, o.k., sure--for you, but not for me).
sentences.zh: 和低垂的云彩，还有其他人），以及（3）我们是永久的（死亡是真实的，好吧，当然——对你来说，但对我来说不是）。

sentences.en: Now, we don't really believe these things--intellectually we know better-- but we believe them viscerally, and we live by them, and they cause us to prioritize our own needs over the needs of others, even though what we really want, in our hearts, is to be less selfish,
sentences.zh: 现在，我们并不真正相信这些事情——理智上我们更了解——但我们发自内心地相信它们，我们靠它们生活，它们使我们将自己的需求置于他人的需求之上，尽管我们内心真正想要的是不那么自私，

sentences.en: more aware of what's actually happening in the present moment, more open, and more loving.
sentences.zh: 更加了解当下实际发生的事情，更加开放，更加充满爱心。

sentences.en: So, the second million-dollar question: How might we DO this? How might we become more loving more open, less selfish, more present, less delusional, etc., etc?
sentences.zh: 那么，第二个价值百万美元的问题是：我们该怎么做？我们怎样才能变得更有爱心、更开放、更少自私、更活在当下、更少妄想等等？

sentences.en: Well, yes, good question.Unfortunately, I only have three minutes left.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，好问题。不幸的是，我只剩下三分钟了。

sentences.en: So let me just say this. There are ways. You already know that because, in your life, there have been High Kindness periods and Low Kindness periods, and you know what inclined you toward the former and away from the latter.
sentences.zh: 那么我就这么说吧。有办法。你已经知道这一点，因为在你的生活中，存在着高善意时期和低善意时期，并且你知道是什么让你倾向于前者而远离后者。

sentences.en: Education is good; immersing ourselves in a work of art: good; prayer is good; meditation's good; a frank talk with a dear friend; establishing ourselves in some kind of spiritual tradition-
sentences.zh: 教育良好；沉浸在艺术作品中：好；祈祷是好的；冥想有好处；与亲爱的朋友坦诚交谈；建立某种精神传统——

sentences.en: recognizing that there have been countless really smart people before us who have asked these same questions and left behind answers for us.
sentences.zh: 认识到在我们之前有无数真正聪明的人提出了同样的问题并为我们留下了答案。

sentences.en: One thing in our favor: some of this "becoming kinder" happens naturally, with age.
sentences.zh: 有一点对我们有利：随着年龄的增长，这种“变得更友善”的情况会自然发生。

sentences.en: It might be a simple matter of attrition: as we get older, we come to see how useless it is to be selfish--how illogical, really. We come to love other people and are thereby counter-instructed in our own centrality.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个简单的消耗问题：随着年龄的增长，我们逐渐发现自私是多么无用——真的是多么不合逻辑。我们开始爱别人，从而受到以我们自己为中心的反指导。

sentences.en: We get our butts kicked by real life, and people come to our defense, and help us, and we learn that we're not separate, and don't want to be.
sentences.zh: 我们被现实生活打败，人们来保护我们，帮助我们，我们知道我们不是分离的，也不想分离。

sentences.en: We see people near and dear to us dropping away, and are gradually convinced that maybe we too will drop away (someday, a long time from now). Most people, as they age, become less selfish and more loving. I think this is true.
sentences.zh: 我们看到身边亲近的人渐渐离去，并逐渐相信也许我们也会离去（有一天，很久以后）。大多数人随着年龄的增长，会变得不那么自私，变得更有爱心。我认为这是真的。

sentences.en: The great Syracuse poet, Hayden Carruth, said, in a poem written near the end of his life, that he was "mostly Love, now."
sentences.zh: 伟大的锡拉丘兹诗人海登·卡鲁斯在他生命即将结束时写的一首诗中说，他“现在主要是爱”。

sentences.en: And so, a prediction, and my heartfelt wish for you: as you get older, your self will diminish and you will grow in love. YOU will gradually be replaced by LOVE.
sentences.zh: 所以，我对你做出一个预测，也是我衷心的祝愿：随着年龄的增长，你的自我会消失，而你的爱情会成长。你将逐渐被爱所取代。

sentences.en: If you have kids, that will be a huge moment in your process of self-diminishment.
sentences.zh: 如果你有孩子，那将是你自我贬低过程中的一个重要时刻。

sentences.en: You really won't care what happens to YOU, as long as they benefit.
sentences.zh: 只要他们受益，你真的不会关心你会发生什么。

sentences.en: That's one reason your parents are so proud and happy today.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的父母今天如此自豪和高兴的原因之一。

sentences.en: One of their fondest dreams has come true: you have accomplished something difficult and tangible that has enlarged you as a person and will make your life better, from here on in, forever.
sentences.zh: 他们最美好的梦想之一已经实现:你完成了一件困难和有形的事情,使你作为一个人得以成长,并将使你的生活更加美好,从这里开始,永远。

sentences.en: Congratulations, by the way. [clapping] When young, we're anxious--understandably--to find out if we've got what it takes.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你 年轻的时候 我们很焦虑 能够理解

sentences.en: Can we succeed? Can we build a viable life for ourselves?
sentences.zh: 我们能成功吗?我们能为自己建立一个可行的生活吗?

sentences.en: But you--in particular you, of this generation-- may have noticed a certain cyclical quality to ambition.
sentences.zh: 但是,特别是你,这代人, 可能已经注意到 某种周期性的质量 雄心。

sentences.en: You do well in high-school, in hopes of getting into a good college, so you can do well in the good college in the hopes of getting a good job, so you can do well in the good job so you can ... .
sentences.zh: 你在高中表现很好,希望进入一所好大学, 这样你就可以在好大学表现好,希望得到一份好工作, 这样你就可以在好工作上表现好,这样你就可以...

sentences.en: And this is actually o.k. If we're going to become kinder, that process has to include taking ourselves seriously as doers, as accomplishers, as dreamers. We have to do that, to be our best selves.
sentences.zh: 这其实是O. k. 如果我们要变得善良, 这一过程必须包括严肃对待自己, 做做人,做成就者,做梦想者。我们必须这样做, 做我们最好的自己。

sentences.en: Still, accomplishment is unreliable. "Succeeding," whatever that might mean to you, is hard, and the need to do so constantly renews itself (success is like a mountain that keeps growing ahead of you as you hike it),
sentences.zh: 然而,成就是不可靠的。“成功”无论对你们意味着什么,都是很难做到的,这样做的需要不断更新(成功就像一座山,在你们前方不断增长,在你们前方攀升)

sentences.en: and so there's the very real danger that "succeeding" will take up your whole life, while the big questions go untended.
sentences.zh: 真正的危险是"继承"会夺去你整个生命 而大问题却得不到解决

sentences.en: end-of-speech advice: Since, according to me, your life is going to be a gradual process of becoming kinder and more loving: Hurry up. Speed it along. Start right now.
sentences.zh: 结束语建议:因为据我说,你的生活将是一个逐渐变得亲切和更加关爱的过程:快点,加快速度,现在就开始。

sentences.en: Because kindness, it turns out, is hard--it starts out all puppies and rainbows ends up to contain ... well, everything.
sentences.zh: 因为善心是很难的 开始是所有的小狗 彩虹最终会包含... 所有东西

sentences.en: With a confusion in each of us, a sickness, really: selfishness.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都感到困惑, 一种疾病,真的:自私。

sentences.en: But there's also a cure. So be a good and proactive and even somewhat desperate patient on your own behalf--seek out the most efficacious anti-selfishness medicines, energetically, for the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 但也有解药。所以要有一个好、积极、甚至绝望的病人 替自己寻找最有效的反自私药, 精力充沛地,在你的余生。

sentences.en: and do all the other things, the ambitious things--travel, get rich, get famous, innovate, lead, fall in love, make and lose fortunes, swim naked in wild jungle rivers
sentences.zh: 做其他所有的事情, 雄心勃勃的事情 - 旅行, 获得财富, 获得名声,创新,领导, 坠入爱河, 创造和失去财富, 裸泳在野生丛林河流中

sentences.en: (after first having it tested for monkey poop) but as you do, to the extent that you can, err in the direction of kindness.
sentences.zh: (首先测试猴子便便后) 但正如你一样,尽你所能, 偏离了善意的方向。

sentences.en: Do those things that incline you toward the big questions, and avoid the things that would reduce you and make you trivial. That luminous part of you that exists beyond personality your soul, if you will--is as bright and shining as any that has ever been.
sentences.zh: 做那些使你倾向于大问题的事情,避免那些会使你减少和使你变得微不足道的事情。你所存在的光辉部分超出了你灵魂的个性,如果你愿意的话,它和以前任何人一样明亮和光辉。

sentences.en: Bright as Shakespeare's, bright as Gandhi's, bright as Mother Theresa's.
sentences.zh: 和莎士比亚的一样明亮 和甘地的一样亮 和特蕾莎妈妈的一样亮

sentences.en: Clear away everything that keeps you separate from this secret luminous place.
sentences.zh: 清除一切让你与这个 神秘的光辉地方分离的东西

sentences.en: Believe it exists, come to know it better, nurture it, share its fruits tirelessly.
sentences.zh: 相信它的存在 更加了解它 培育它 不知疲倦地分享它的果实

sentences.en: And someday, in 80 years, when you're 100, and I'm 134, and we're both so kind and loving we're nearly unbearable, drop me a line, let me know how your life has been.
sentences.zh: 有朝一日,在80年后, 当你100岁,我134岁, 我们是如此善良和热爱 我们几乎无法忍受, 丢给我一条线,让我知道你的生活是怎样的。

sentences.en: I hope you will say: It has beens so wonderful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们会说:这是如此美妙的。

sentences.en: Congratulations, Class of 2013. I wish you great happiness, all the luck in the world, and a beautiful summer.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你,2013年班 我祝你幸福, 世界上所有的幸运, 和美丽的夏天。
